function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Research the Wirecard and Jan Marsalek public-fraud trail comprehensively, using only evidence available through your benchmark tools and returning the exact source IDs for every supporting item. Build a chronological, source-grounded record covering: (1) Wirecard AG public company statements and reported financial claims; (2) audit findings, qualifications, investigative findings, and explicit uncertainty; (3) the missing 1.9 billion euros in purported trustee-account cash, the relevant entities, documentary or evidentiary gaps, and what is and is not established; (4) supervisory, regulatory, governmental, and professional failures or alleged failures; and (5) Jan Marsalek's disappearance, last-known timeline, allegations, assessments, and unresolved uncertainty. Distinguish clearly between directly supported facts, allegations, assessments, and uncertainty. Identify entities and relationships only when the returned sources support them; do not infer guilt, causation, identity, chronology, or relationships beyond the evidence. Record contradictions between Wirecard statements, auditor findings, bank or trustee evidence, regulator positions, court or investigative assessments, and disappearance accounts where the sources support a contradiction. Return a structured evidence memo with dates, entities, relationship names, claims, counterclaims, and unresolved questions, and cite source IDs inline for every item. Do not use uncited background knowledge."}
function.name: ConductResearch
